title: No type checker is implemented
rationale: The introduction sketches Hindley-Milner rules. The compiler has no type checker, so those rules are not compatibility requirements yet.
note: SPEC_GAP: unknown names, amount-versus-address, and negative-to-unsigned checks are not implemented. Do not treat zero-substitution as the type system.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { x : Int = 0 }
Clauses
  Clause A(): Effect
    Provided That
      x == 0
    Shall
      Set { field: "x", value: 1 }
End
